title: Characteristic quadratic estimates in the weak boundary form
reviewed_arguments: W1 proves uniform tangential maps and the exact parameter normal commutator, with every mixed pairing at its stated orders.
W2 normalizes the full two-by-two operator matrix and applies the exact Hilbert sharp lower bound at order zero. All lower-order and non-Hermitian errors have the precise X0 quadratic bound.
W3 proves that the order-minus-one tangential operator is a legal test in both original energy domains, by boundedness and the defining Dirichlet closure.
WQ14 retains the principal form, its complete normal parameter commutator and the ordered tangential GR term. No normal integration by parts removes a boundary functional.
W4 estimates every derivative-on-solution and derivative-on-test complex lower matrix, in their actual opposite normal-factor positions, with the full natural-antidual source.
W5 quantizes the characteristic completion and proves the exact weak form inequality. The operator array, its order-minus-one normalized remainder and all density limits are explicit.
Uniformity is asserted for the chosen completion symbols and bounded operator families; no unjustified uniform smooth extension bound is inferred from characteristic values alone.
W6 constructs the actual two-row order-zero inverse through one order of calculus, retains its remainder, and identifies the exact localized X1/2 mixed norm through the normal commutator.
W7 uses one compact support convention and actual original tests. It never asserts a global cutoff equation or identifies an unproved invariant mixed norm under coordinate change.

Three complete exercises check the exact boundary sign, both non-Hermitian lower pairings and the two-sided row inverse. The original two-panel illustration gives their precise pairings and weight gap.
Five finite groups with 66 cases, 238 formulae, 38 numbered displays and all 15 reader captures are checked. Finite cases supplement the full arguments.
The full rough normal-commutant estimate, regularizer limits, connection to the energy-b front and strict-diffractive propagation remain unfinished.
